thread:
samir: Heads up — NovaHealth POC asked for SOC 2 report, ISO artifacts, and a signed pen-test letter. They specifically called out encryption-at-rest details and KMS flow. deadline: next Friday EOD.
claire: Thanks — do we have a one-pager mapping of which artifacts we give publicly vs gated?
raj: We usually gate anything with customer-specific infra or keys. SOC 2 (summary + scope) is okay to share. Full ISMS + config screenshots we put behind an NDA.
elena-legal: @samir can you confirm whether the customer will sign our standard pen-test letter or needs a redline? If they need additional attestations, that'll take legal time.
samir: They said their procurement team expects a signed letter within 10 business days. Might need to expedite.
claire: Quick proposal: create a decision tree for artifact gating. If customer is regulated (finance/health) -> require signed pen-test + full SOC2 package + onprem networking docs. If not regulated -> SOC2 summary + redacted pen-test letter + network diagram high-level.
raj: That sounds good. Also note: for Dedicated/Dedicated+Private options, we include KMS flow docs and HSM notes. For Hosted, we provide encryption-at-rest architecture diagram and key rotation policy.
elena-legal: I'll flag any clauses that can't be agreed to. If NovaHealth insists on a timeline for vuln remediation beyond our SLA we need to escalate.
infra-bot: deploy-notify: artifact-bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/novahealth-234567 (restricted).
claire: Perfect. Samir can you upload the SOC2 summary and the standard pen-test letter to that bucket? Use the upload checklist.
samir: On it. Uploading now. Will add a README with what is redacted.
raj: Upload snippet for infra team (if helpful):
```
aws s3 cp ./SOC2-summary.pdf s3://redwood-evidence/novahealth-234567/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/evidence-key
```
claire: Nice. Also can we provide an estimated cost delta if they want Dedicated with 99th percentile latency SLA? Finance needs an anchor.
elena-legal: For anything SLA-related we need procurement to sign the addendum. That will affect pricing and legal turnaround.
samir: FYI sales asked for a pricing note: add $12k/month baseline + $1.8k/month per reserved GPU for the POC. This is ballpark until pricing review.
claire: We'll label that as "preliminary" in the shared packet.
raj: A couple of blockers to call out: 1) If they want red team results, we only share redacted executive summary. 2) If they request network-level pcap logs, we cannot provide customer-tenant logs.
elena-legal: Also: pen-test letter needs signatory with authority. We'll propose our CISO. If they request alternate signatory, send a request and reason.
samir: I uploaded SOC2-summary.pdf and standard-pen-test-letter.pdf to the bucket and added README_v1.md with gating decisions. Link: <https://secure.redwood.com/evidence/novahealth-234567> (internal).
claire: Great. Can you also include the list of personnel that might respond to their audit Qs? They usually ask for an ops contact and an infra contact.
samir: Added contact list: claire (sales-ops), raj (infra).
infra-bot: vault-access-log: temporary credentials requested by novahealth-poc-team; request id: rq-99823, expires in 48h.
raj: I'll provision a staging VPC with limited access for their pen-test window; will need timeline from them.
elena-legal: Timeline is critical. If they want pen-test results before we close POC, ensure we have explicit scope and duration. Otherwise we'll only provide the letter saying a test was conducted by a third party.
claire: I'll ask procurement to confirm whether they will sign our standard pen-test attestation or propose edits. Samir, can you chase procurement?
samir: Reached out, they responded: "we prefer a publisher-signed letter + vendor point of contact; can you provide remediation SLAs?"
elena-legal: We'll provide remediation SLA language in the addendum; Clara/sales should sign off.
claire: One more ask — finance wants to know if sharing ISO artifacts triggers any cost (e.g., redaction effort). Estimate 2-3 hours of engineering + 1 hour legal. Costed at internal rates will be in the packet.
raj: I can do the redactions with a script; will need approved list of fields to remove.
samir: I'll get that list from NovaHealth.
elena-legal: If they request SOC2 logs or raw evidence, deny and offer to party-witness with our auditor instead.
claire: OK — next steps assigned: Samir (procurement follow-up + uploads), Raj (prep staging VPC + redaction script), Elena-legal (draft pen-test addendum + signatory note), Claire (pricing anchor + evidence packet). Deadline: EOD Friday for initial packet to the customer.
samir: Noted. ping me if anyone needs anything else. :thumbsup:
claire: Thanks team — will update thread with any procurement redlines.
raj: FYI I'll book a 30m sync if legal needs to review the network diagrams.
elena-legal: Happy to.
samir: Closing loop — uploaded a final README_v2.md with decision-tree diagram and a short Q&A for common audit asks.
claire: Love it. Marking as ready for review. :rocket:
